{"metadata":{"description":"Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders pages in a real browser, denoises them (Readability + DOMPurify), and returns markdown.","id":"gh:1341712226","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-web-fetch-playwright","slug":"chendefine/dsh-web-fetch-playwright","topics":["cordis","deepseek-harness","dsh","dsh-bundle","dsh-plugin","fetch-provider","markdown","playwright","web-fetch"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"Playwright/CDP web-fetch provider for DeepSeek Harness: renders pages in a real browser, denoises th"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"em (Readability + DOMPurify), and returns markdown."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-web-fetch-playwright"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"中文 · npm · GitHub"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (DSH) plugin that gives the built-in `web_fetch` tool a **Playwright/CDP backend*"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"*: pages are rendered in a real browser, denoised with **Readability + DOMPurify + Turndown + GFM**,"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" and returned as Markdown."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Real browser rendering** — loads the page the way a user sees it, so client-side rendered (SPA) "},{"id":"p6s2","text":"content is captured, not just the raw HTML.
- **Denoise pipeline** — Mozilla Readability extracts th"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"e article, DOMPurify removes layout/noise tags (nav, sidebar, footer, ads, forms), and Turndown with"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" the GFM plugin converts to Markdown with the same style options as the shipped `tool-web` renderer."},{"id":"p6s5","text":" Inline `data:` images (build tools like Docusaurus embed screenshots as base64) are elided to size "},{"id":"p6s6","text":"placeholders such as `!alt` so they cannot flood the body. On list-shaped pages (portals, catalogs) "},{"id":"p6s7","text":"where the content *is* the links, Readability's link-density scoring picks a noise fragment — a cove"},{"id":"p6s8","text":"rage gate therefore distrusts an extraction under 250 characters or covering under 10% of the page's"},{"id":"p6s9","text":" visible text (measured on the 163.com homepage: 96 characters of footer licensing won while 320 hea"},{"id":"p6s10","text":"dlines scored near zero), and the pipeline falls back to the sanitized whole document, which on such"},{"id":"p6s11","text":" pages keeps effectively all list content.
- **Two backends** — launch a local Playwright browser, o"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"r drive an already-running browser over its DevTools Protocol (CDP) endpoint.
- **Browser resolution"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"** — a configured path, a `playwright` CLI on `$PATH`, or the bundled `playwright-core`; CDP needs n"},{"id":"p6s14","text":"o local browser at all.
- **Shared profile or reusable isolation (CDP)** — each fetch opens and clos"},{"id":"p6s15","text":"es its own tab; session isolation uses a dedicated CDP connection per DSH session, while global/prof"},{"id":"p6s16","text":"ile modes share one connection. By default it uses the browser's existing default context and logins"},{"id":"p6s17","text":" (`connectOverCDP` → `browser.contexts()[0]`, like CLI CDP attach with isolation disabled, not `play"},{"id":"p6s18","text":"wright-cli open`). Session isolation creates an in-memory context on demand and shares it only while"},{"id":"p6s19","text":" same-session fetches or other tabs keep it in use; global isolation retains one fixed isolated cont"},{"id":"p6s20","text":"ext across all sessions within the same plugin instance. Local launches still close their browser pe"},{"id":"p6s21","text":"ssions within the same plugin instance. Local launches still close their browser per fetch.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"| Half | Location | Responsibility |"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"| Host (server) | `src/` | Registers the fetch provider (id `playwright`) into `ctx.web`; `cordis.pa"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"tch.yml` pins the web seam's `fetchProvider` to it and enables the `web_fetch` tool with a 60s budge"},{"id":"p9s3","text":"t. |
| Browser (client) | `src/client/` | Registers the *Playwright web fetch* configuration form on"},{"id":"p9s4","text":" the Plugins page's `plugins.bundle.config` / `plugins.row.config` seats, which stages edits and wri"},{"id":"p9s5","text":"tes them through the shared settings form service. |"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"**Non-2xx statuses are results, not errors** — the web seam's contract (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web`): a f"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"etched 404/418/500 comes back with its status code, exactly what `dsh-web-fetch-http` does. Chromium"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" complicates this for *status-only* responses — an error status with an empty body (httpbin's `/stat"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"us/404`) fails the whole navigation with `net::ERR_HTTP_RESPONSE_CODE_FAILURE`, and a 204/205 is abo"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"rted (`net::ERR_ABORTED`) because nothing is renderable. The provider therefore tracks the last main"},{"id":"p11s6","text":"-frame response on every fetch (that response arrives before Chromium fails the navigation) and reco"},{"id":"p11s7","text":"vers such failures into the status-bearing result, so `web_fetch` reports `Fetched … (HTTP 404)` ins"},{"id":"p11s8","text":"tead of a `WEB_PROVIDER_ERROR` throw. The same recovery covers *download* responses — a body served "},{"id":"p11s9","text":"with `Content-Disposition: attachment` (publish.twitter.com's oembed endpoint, the URL agents use to"},{"id":"p11s10","text":" read a tweet, serves its JSON exactly that way) never commits a document: `goto` rejects with `Down"},{"id":"p11s11","text":"load is starting` and the body is gone from the network stack, so the provider refetches it through "},{"id":"p11s12","text":"the page's API request context and returns the decodable content; undecodable downloads (a PDF, a ZI"},{"id":"p11s13","text":"e's API request context and returns the decodable content; undecodable downloads (a PDF, a ZI [长行截断]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- DSH web profile (`dsh web`), Node.js ≥ 20.
- For the **local** backend: a Playwright installation "},{"id":"p14s2","text":"with Chromium, a Chromium-family browser binary, or `playwright-core` with a browser in the default "},{"id":"p14s3","text":"cache.
- For the **CDP** backend: any browser already running with `--remote-debugging-port` (e.g. `"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"chromium --headless --remote-debugging-port=9222`)."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"From the npm registry (prebuilt — no build permission needed):"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"From a GitHub repository (source — pnpm runs the `prepare` build; allowlist the package in `profiles"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"/web/pnpm-workspace.yaml` if pnpm blocks the build script):"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Or through the DSH plugin marketplace (设置 → DSH插件市场) — the repo carries the `dsh-plugin` topic and i"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"s indexed automatically."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"After a bundle plugin is added to the profile layer stack, **restart `dsh web`** for it to load; uni"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"nstall with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-fetch-playwright` and restart again."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"## Configuration"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"The Plugins page (侧边栏 → 插件) opens the form one click from the list: the *dsh-web-fetch-playwright* c"},{"id":"p23s2","text":"ard lands on the package page with the full form between its description and its rows, and the row's"},{"id":"p23s3","text":" own configure control opens the same form under the plugin's title. It edits the `web-fetch-playwri"},{"id":"p23s4","text":"ght` settings section — derived from the plugin entry's `Config` schema — live:"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p26s1","text":"Same stance as the built-in HTTP provider: **no SSRF / private-network protection is implemented** —"},{"id":"p26s2","text":" anything the browser can reach, this provider can fetch. The CDP endpoint is configured from the se"},{"id":"p26s3","text":"ttings page with no loopback restriction, so only expose the settings page to trusted environments. "},{"id":"p26s4","text":"Fetched pages are rendered locally; no data is sent anywhere beyond the target page itself — but not"},{"id":"p26s5","text":"e that in profile mode the requests (and any state changes a malicious page tricks the agent into) c"},{"id":"p26s6","text":"arry the remote browser's logged-in sessions (see the risk notes above)."}],"truncated":true}
